title: Events all year round
body: Social meetups, tech talks, panels, workshops and career development — most months have something. Events are free or $5 or less, hosted at accessible locations around Madison and Dane County, and usually open to all genders.
photoAlt: A speaker presenting to Madison Women in Tech members at a tech talk
